collision_check: Searched 195 openkit-*/fbx for seal|wax|matrix|graver|burin|sanding|signet|handle-blank|punch|spoon. Near-misses: prop-sealing-wax-stick (scribe pack, finished stick), prop-wax-block-stack, various punch dies, spoon-carver pack. No seal-engraver pack, no matrix/graver/burin/sanding ids; no suffix needed (prop-graver-set used without -se1).
judgment_calls: Wax blank = rough untrimmed cast bar + poured cake puddle on slate cooling tile, no wick/label/taper, differs from finished sealing-wax-stick
Matrix blanks have smooth uncut faces (brass disc + bone cylinder) on a holding block: no device/heraldry
Graver set: two burins on low tray; shaft lowered 0.5 mm after v1 eye-check so it rests on tray floor
Sanding pad: leather-faced lapping block with grit smear + pumice lump touching pad side
Eye-check v2 contact sheet: all parts grounded, no floating parts

pack_files_note: Ship set; excludes INTAKE*, *.VEIL.md and src/ (build sources kept in studio, not shipped)
textures_note: All ten BaseColor PNGs ship pack-local in tex/. None is byte-identical to any sibling openkit-*-props-b1 pack. T_Bone, T_Boxwood, T_Brass, T_Leather, T_Pumice, T_Steel, T_Wax_Red and T_Wood_Ash are name-clash only with other Open Kit packs (different bytes); T_Grit and T_Slate are unique. FBX carry material slots only; Unity maps textures by material slot.
